title: Replayable SLI Debug Harness for Analytics Pipelines
creator: Asha Menon
description: Problem: When an analytics SLI (e.g., ingestion latency, event loss rate, per-tenant query delay) breaches, it's difficult to deterministically reproduce the exact conditions that caused the regression because: (1) event sampling changes over time, (2) trace context is often not persisted end-to-end, and (3) downstream transforms (normalization, enrichment) are non-idempotent. This ticket implements a 'replayable SLI debug harness' that lets engineers re-run a bounded window of raw events through the analytics pipeline with preserved trace context and deterministic configs to reproduce SLI violations and produce RCA artifacts for dashboards and on-call runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A replay endpoint that accepts a time window + tenant filter and replays events into a sandbox pipeline with preserved trace IDs and deterministic ingestion configs; 2) Replayed runs produce identical SLI telemetry for the selected window within acceptable variance (<= 2% delta); 3) Trace artifacts (span tree, per-stage timing) are output to an isolated Grafana/Jaeger view and linked to the original alert; 4) Cost and rate-limits enforced so replay cannot affect production quotas; 5) Runbook added to Console docs describing how to request a replay and interpret artifacts.
tasks: Design replay API & auth model (tokenized replay requests referencing original alert)
Persist minimal raw-event archive for 72h to support replay windows (S3 prefix + manifest)
Enhance ingest service to attach canonical trace context and deterministic RNG seeds for replay mode
Implement sandbox pipeline orchestration (K8s Job + isolated downstream connectors)
Instrument per-stage SLI metrics and span tagging for replay runs
Build a lightweight Grafana dashboard template for replay RCAs and link it from alerts
Add cost control: per-tenant replay quota and throttling policy
design_decisions: Use event archive instead of full Kafka retention to minimize storage and avoid changing prod retention settings
Replay will be read-only for primary data stores to prevent side effects; any writes use a test namespace
Determinism achieved by replay-mode flags: fixed RNG seed, fixed feature-flag matrix snapshot, and no asynchronous batching variability
Trace context preserved via atomic span_id/span_trace_id fields in archived events rather than relying on ephemeral headers
tradeoffs: Storage vs. coverage: 72h archive covers most on-call windows but increases S3 costs; extending to 7d would materially raise cost
Determinism effort vs. fidelity: enforcing strict deterministic behavior may hide race conditions that only occur in production non-deterministic paths
Sandbox complexity vs. speed: creating isolated connectors increases flip time for replays but prevents accidental production writes
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Implement replay for ingestion -> enrichment stages for 10% of alerts (internal only)
Phase 2: Expand replay coverage to entire analytics pipeline and expose to on-call via Console alert UI
Phase 3: Self-serve replay requests for customers with Dedicated seats behind RBAC and audit logging
monitoring_plan: Track 'replay_runs.total' and 'replay_runs.failed' metrics in console-telemetry; alert if failure_rate > 5% over 1h
Add SLI delta dashboard comparing original run vs replayed run for latency, success-rate, and per-stage duration
Audit log entries for each replay request (user, tenant, window, policy) stored for compliance
migrations_and_backwards_compatibility: Archive manifest format is backward-compatible; new fields prefixed with 'replay_'
If downstream connector does not support sandbox mode, replay will emulate write side-effects and provide a dry-run diff
Graceful fallback: if trace IDs are missing in archived events, replay will generate synthetic trace IDs and flag lower-fidelity in the RCA

risks: Replaying high-volume windows could pressure downstream connectors if throttling is not enforced
Deterministic mode may not capture concurrency-related resource contention bugs
Potential privacy/compliance concerns for archived raw events—must ensure masking and RBAC
next_steps: Finish archiver integration and add replay manifest retention pruning job
Implement replay authorization service and one-time tokens (authn + audit logging)
Wire Grafana dashboard template into alert UI and add link generation for replay runs
